Package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led

package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led
The UNO R4 WiFi's built-in 12x8 LED matrix: LedMatrix, the raw compiler-intrinsic begin/loadFrame/clear operations, and LedCanvas, a boolean[HEIGHT][WIDTH] pixel buffer with shape and text drawing helpers that render into it and send it to the hardware with show.

LedMatrixFont (5x7 digits/uppercase), LedMatrixFontAscii (5x7, full printable ASCII), and LedMatrixFontSmall (a compact 3x5 digit font) are bitmap fonts for drawing text one glyph at a time onto an LedCanvas frame — Juno v0.1 has neither arrays of pre-built glyph data nor a String-aware "print" entry point here, so each font instead encodes a glyph as a small function returning whether one pixel is lit, and only the glyphs a program actually calls are linked into the generated firmware.

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    LedCanvas
    A 12x8 pixel buffer for the UNO R4 WiFi's built-in LED matrix, plus the shape and text drawing operations that paint into it.
    LedMatrix
    UNO R4 WiFi 12x8 built-in LED matrix operations recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    LedMatrixFont
    A classic 5x7 dot-matrix font for digits and uppercase letters, sized to fit the UNO R4 WiFi's 12x8 LED matrix (two glyphs fit side by side: 5 + 1 gap + 5 = 11 of the 12 columns).
    LedMatrixFontAscii
    A 5x7 dot-matrix font covering the full printable ASCII range (32 space .. 126 ~), for printing arbitrary ASCII characters on the UNO R4 WiFi's 12x8 LED matrix one at a time (two glyphs fit side by side: 5 + 1 gap + 5 = 11 of the 12 columns).
    LedMatrixFontSmall
    A compact 3x5 dot-matrix font for digits 0-9, offered as a smaller alternative to the 5x7 LedMatrixFont (which it does not replace).
